1: // Simple Orbit Dodge game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7: 
8:   // Resize canvas to fill its container
9:   function resize() {
10:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
11:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
12:   }
13:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
14:   resize();
15: 
16:   const planet = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2, r: 30 };
17: 
18:   const ship = {
19:     angle: 0, // radians around planet
20:     radius: 80, // distance from planet centre
21:     speedAngle: 0, // angular velocity
22:     speedRadial: 0, // radial velocity
23:     r: 8,
24:     maxSpeed: 4,
25:     thrust: 0.1,
26:     brake: 0.05,
27:     rotateSpeed: 0.04,
28:   };
29: 
30:   const keys = {};
31:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
32:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
33: 
34:   // Asteroid handling
35:   const asteroids = [];
36:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 2000; // ms
37:   let lastSpawn = 0;
38: 
39:   function spawnAsteroid() {
40:     // spawn at random edge position
41:     const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
42:     let x, y, vx, vy;
43:     const speed = 1.5 + Math.random();
44:     if (side === 0) { // top
45:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
46:       y = -20;
47:     } else if (side === 1) { // right
48:       x = canvas.width + 20;
49:       y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
50:     } else if (side === 2) { // bottom
51:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
52:       y = canvas.height + 20;
53:     } else { // left
54:       x = -20;
55:       y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
56:     }
57:     // direction towards planet centre
58:     const dx = planet.x - x;
59:     const dy = planet.y - y;
60:     const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
61:     vx = (dx / len) * speed;
62:     vy = (dy / len) * speed;
63:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r: 10 + Math.random() * 5 });
64:   }
65: 
66:   let gameOver = false;
67: 
68:   function update(dt) {
69:     if (gameOver) return;
70:     // handle input
71:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.speedAngle -= ship.rotateSpeed;
72:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.speedAngle += ship.rotateSpeed;
73:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) ship.speedRadial += ship.thrust;
74:     if (keys['ArrowDown']) ship.speedRadial -= ship.brake;
75: 
76:     // apply friction
77:     ship.speedRadial *= 0.98;
78:     ship.speedAngle *= 0.99;
79: 
80:     // update ship position
81:     ship.angle += ship.speedAngle;
82:     ship.radius += ship.speedRadial;
83:     // clamp radius to stay outside planet
84:     const minRadius = planet.r + ship.r + 5;
85:     if (ship.radius < minRadius) ship.radius = minRadius;
86:     if (ship.radius > Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) / 2 - ship.r) ship.radius = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) / 2 - ship.r;
87: 
88:     // spawn asteroids
89:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
90:       spawnAsteroid();
91:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
92:     }
93: 
94:     // update asteroids
95:     for (const a of asteroids) {
96:       a.x += a.vx;
97:       a.y += a.vy;
98:     }
99: 
100:     // collision detection
101:     const sx = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
102:     const sy = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
103:     for (const a of asteroids) {
104:       const dist = Math.hypot(a.x - sx, a.y - sy);
105:       if (dist < a.r + ship.r) {
106:         gameOver = true;
107:         break;
108:       }
109:     }
110:   }
111: 
112:   function draw() {
113:     // clear
114:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
115:     // planet
116:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
117:     ctx.beginPath();
118:     ctx.arc(planet.x, planet.y, planet.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
119:     ctx.fill();
120:     // ship
121:     const sx = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
122:     const sy = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
123:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
124:     ctx.beginPath();
125:     ctx.arc(sx, sy, ship.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
126:     ctx.fill();
127:     // asteroids
128:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a33';
129:     for (const a of asteroids) {
130:       ctx.beginPath();
131:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
132:       ctx.fill();
133:     }
134:     if (gameOver) {
135:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
136:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
137:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
138:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
139:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
140:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
141:     }
142:   }
143: 
144:   let last = performance.now();
145:   function loop(now) {
146:     const dt = now - last;
147:     last = now;
148:     update(dt);
149:     draw();
150:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
151:   }
152:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
153: })();

(End of file - total 153 lines)
</content>
